abstract: This study aims to examine the relationship between the digital economy and the environmental development gap between the eastern and western regions of China. Using urban panel data from 2003 to 2021, we apply the entropy method to measure the development levels of the digital economy and environmental performance across cities. The study systematically analyzes the impact and mechanisms of the digital economy in narrowing the environmental development gap. Furthermore, it examines the effects of its linkage on promoting regional convergence and common prosperity. The findings show that: First, the development of the digital economy significantly reduces the environmental development gap between the eastern and western regions. Second, mechanism analysis reveals that the digital economy promotes green technological innovation, improving carbon productivity and energy efficiency, thereby helping to narrow the gap. Third, the digital economy fosters environmental development in neighbouring cities, exhibiting significant spatial spillover effects. Fourth, digital economy exhibits significant linkage effects in promoting environmental equity and supporting the realization of common prosperity, with micro-level mechanisms indicating that the digital economy can increase the incomes of rural residents. Overall, the development of the digital economy not only narrows regional environmental disparities but also promotes broader economic and social objectives.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨数字经济与中国东西部地区环境发展差距之间的关系。利用2003年至2021年的城市面板数据，我们采用熵值法衡量各城市数字经济发展水平和环境绩效。研究系统分析了数字经济在缩小环境发展差距方面的影响及其作用机制，并进一步考察了其联动效应在促进区域趋同与共同富裕中的作用。研究发现：第一，数字经济的发展显著缩小了东西部地区之间的环境发展差距。第二，机制分析表明，数字经济促进绿色技术创新，提升碳生产率和能源效率，从而有助于缩小差距。第三，数字经济对邻近城市的环境发展具有促进作用，表现出显著的空间溢出效应。第四，数字经济在促进环境公平和支持实现共同富裕方面展现出显著的联动效应，微观层面的机制表明，数字经济能够增加农村居民收入。总体而言，数字经济的发展不仅缩小了区域环境差异，还推动了更广泛的经济和社会目标的实现。

title: Bridging the East-West environmental development gap in China: the role and mechanisms of the digital economy in promoting common prosperity
title_zh: 弥合中国东西部环境发展差距：数字经济促进共同富裕的作用与机制

abstract: Using data from Chinese listed companies, this study examines the overall impact of the smart city policy (SCP) on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, focusing on the distinct effects across the E, S, and G dimensions. Using a multiperiod difference-in-differences (DID) approach, we analyse 24647 firm-year observations from 2009 to 2021, leveraging the three-stage SCP rollout as a quasi-natural experiment. The results indicate that the SCP improves corporate ESG scores by approximately 0.04, with significant enhancements in governance performance. Mechanism analysis also reveals that the SCP fosters ESG improvements through increased R&D investments and market attention, while executive environmental awareness has limited effects. Policy impacts also vary by ownership and industry, with state-owned enterprises, industrial firms, and companies in low-pollution and high-technology sectors obtaining the greatest benefits. Robustness checks, including alternative models and PSM-DID estimations, confirm these findings. Moreover, interaction analysis indicates that the SCP and other sustainability-focused policies (e.g. green credit and resource city policies) act as substitutes rather than complements due to policy priority and resource constraints for companies. Our findings underscore the importance of a coordinated policy design to maximize the collective effectiveness of policies in promoting sustainable corporate practices.
abstract_zh: 基于中国上市公司数据，本研究考察了智慧城市政策（SCP）对企业环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效的整体影响，重点关注其在E、S、G三个维度上的差异化效应。采用多期双重差分（DID）方法，我们分析了2009年至2021年间24647个公司-年度观测值，将三阶段SCP推广作为准自然实验。结果表明，SCP使企业ESG得分提升约0.04，其中治理绩效的改善尤为显著。机制分析进一步揭示，SCP通过增加研发投入和市场关注度促进ESG改善，而高管环境意识的影响有限。政策效应因所有权性质和行业类型而异，国有企业、工业企业以及低污染和高科技行业的企业获益最大。包括替代模型和倾向得分匹配双重差分（PSM-DID）估计在内的稳健性检验证实了上述发现。此外，交互效应分析表明，由于政策优先级和企业资源约束，SCP与其他可持续发展导向政策（如绿色信贷政策和资源型城市政策）呈现替代而非互补关系。本研究结果强调了协调政策设计对于最大化政策组合在促进企业可持续实践方面整体效能的重要性。

title: Better city, better life: smart city policy and corporate ESG performance

abstract: This paper assesses the impact of debt-for-nature swaps on sustainable development in developing countries, using entropy balancing on a large sample of 127 countries from 1990 to 2020. The findings indicate that debt-for-nature swaps have a positive and statistically significant effect on sustainable development, operating through several key channels: public debt reduction, increased public investment, lower CO2 emissions, and improved human development. The additional results found in this paper show that if treated countries had not benefited from debt-for-nature swaps, their sustainable development index would have decreased by 11%. At the same time, if untreated countries had benefited from debt-for-nature swaps, their sustainable development index would have increased by around 2%. The analysis also reveals a non-linear relationship between the size of debt-for-nature swaps and the sustainable development index, with an optimal threshold estimated at 42% of the public debt level, beyond which diminishing returns are observed. These results suggest that debt-for-nature swaps can serve as an effective financing tool for sustainable development, provided that they are appropriately designed. From a policy perspective, expanding debt-for-nature swap programs requires broadening eligibility criteria, strengthening transparency and governance of environmental funds, and more systematically integrating climate objectives into multilateral debt relief mechanisms. Enhanced coordination between public and private creditors, as well as environmental organizations, is also crucial to ensure that debt-for-nature swaps support the ecological transition effectively in the most vulnerable countries.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了债务换自然互换对发展中国家可持续发展的影响，采用熵平衡方法，基于1990年至2020年间127个国家的广泛样本进行分析。研究发现，债务换自然互换对可持续发展具有正向且统计显著的影响，其作用机制主要通过几个关键渠道实现：公共债务减少、公共投资增加、二氧化碳排放降低以及人类发展水平提升。本文的额外结果显示，若受处理国家未受益于债务换自然互换，其可持续发展指数将下降11%；同时，若未受处理国家受益于债务换自然互换，其可持续发展指数将上升约2%。分析还揭示了债务换自然互换规模与可持续发展指数之间的非线性关系，估计最优阈值为公共债务水平的42%，超过此阈值则观察到边际收益递减。这些结果表明，债务换自然互换可作为可持续发展的有效融资工具，前提是其设计得当。从政策角度看，扩大债务换自然互换项目需要拓宽资格标准、加强环境基金的透明度与治理，并更系统地将气候目标纳入多边债务减免机制。加强公共与私人债权人以及环境组织之间的协调，对于确保债务换自然互换在最脆弱国家有效支持生态转型也至关重要。
authors: Yacouba Coulibaly Université d’Orléans, LEO, Orléans
title: Achieving sustainable development and debt sustainability in developing countries: to what extent do debt-for-nature swaps matter?
title_zh: 发展中国家实现可持续发展与债务可持续性：债务自然互换的作用有多大？

abstract: Taking the Yangtze River Delta region of China as a case study, this study empirically demonstrates the long-run heterogeneous effects of the late Qing dynasty open port and trade policy on urban green economic efficiency using the asymptotic spatial DID methodology based on data from 2011 to 2022. The study confirms that the policy of opening ports for trade and commerce at the end of the Qing Dynasty objectively increased the long-term green total factor productivity (GTFP) and green technical efficiency (EC) of the cities, but had no significant effect on green technological progress (TC). The above effects vary according to the timing of the city’s opening, political status and heterogeneity of the power of the Great Powers. Under the combined effects of financial stability, technological progress and policy mechanisms, openness policymaking should fully consider the potential roles of political systems, legal traditions and path dependence, and innovate policies with lower implementation costs, such as green technology transfer and foreign education. This study reveals the dynamic impact of the history of economic openness on the efficiency of the green economy from both the historical and spatial dimensions, providing important insights into the path of green economic development.
abstract_zh: 以中国长三角地区为案例，本研究基于2011年至2022年的数据，采用渐近空间双重差分法，实证揭示了晚清开埠通商政策对城市绿色经济效率的长期异质性影响。研究确认，清末开埠通商政策客观上提升了城市的长期绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）及绿色技术效率（EC），但对绿色技术进步（TC）未产生显著影响。上述效应因城市开埠时间、政治地位及列强势力的异质性而有所不同。在金融稳定、技术进步与政策机制的综合作用下，开放政策的制定应充分考虑政治体制、法律传统及路径依赖的潜在作用，并创新实施成本较低的政策，如绿色技术转移与海外教育。本研究从历史与空间维度揭示了经济开放历史对绿色经济效率的动态影响，为绿色经济发展路径提供了重要启示。
authors: Haisheng Chen Manhong Shen a Institute for Digital Economy and Industrial Innovation

title: A study of the impact of port opening and trade on the efficiency of the green economy: a test based on the asymptotic spatial DID approach
title_zh: 港口开放与贸易对绿色经济效率的影响研究：基于渐进空间双重差分法的检验

abstract: There is a prevailing claim, particularly among proponents of modern monetary theory (MMT), which sovereign defaults on public debt denominated in a sovereign currency can be avoided through monetization. Despite considerable opposition to this assertion, to the best of the authors‘ knowledge, no rigorous empirical analysis has been conducted to test this proposition. This study aims to fill this gap by statistically analysing the validity of the proposition using traditional logistic regression and a machine-learning technique known as random forest. The findings suggest that, although the share of public debt denominated in a sovereign currency indeed reduces the probability of sovereign default, other factors, such as the public debt-to-gross domestic product ratio and the economic growth rate, do significantly influence the probability of sovereign default. These results indicate that the data do not support the MMT’s assertion.
abstract_zh: 有一种普遍观点，尤其在现代货币理论（MMT）的支持者中流传，认为以主权货币计价的公共债务可以通过货币化来避免主权违约。尽管这一论断面临相当大的反对意见，但据作者所知，尚无严谨的实证分析对此命题进行检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白，通过使用传统逻辑回归和一种称为随机森林的机器学习技术，对命题的有效性进行统计分析。研究结果表明，尽管以主权货币计价的公共债务比例确实降低了主权违约的概率，但其他因素，如公共债务与国内生产总值之比以及经济增长率，确实显著影响主权违约的概率。这些结果说明，数据并不支持MMT的论断。
authors: Masaki Fukui Shogo Yoshida Keigo Kameda a School of Policy Studies
Japanb Nomura Asset Management Co. Ltd., Koto
title: Empirical analysis of monetization and sovereign default: a logit and random forest analysis
title_zh: 货币化与主权违约的实证分析：基于Logit与随机森林方法

abstract: This research explores the impact of severe physical climate risks on corporate investment decisions and outcomes, focusing on the role of cultural differences in shaping this relationship among emerging economies. Using a sample of 308,451 firm-year observations across 51 countries covering 2007 to 2019, we find that physical climate risks significantly reduce investment efficiency. Our analyses of cultural differences show that firms in hierarchical cultures adopt more conservative investment approaches, limiting adaptability to climate challenges, while firms in risk-averse cultures proactively integrate climate risks, leading to better investment efficiency. A difference-in-differences analysis further shows that the Paris Agreement led to modest short-term improvements in climate-related investment responses, though longer-term challenges remain. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating cultural context into policy and corporate governance strategies to enhance climate resilience. For robustness, we use System-GMM estimation, helping to account for potential endogeneity and dynamic firm-level factors.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了严重物理气候风险对企业投资决策及结果的影响，并聚焦于文化差异在塑造新兴经济体这一关系中的作用。基于2007年至2019年间覆盖51个国家的308,451个公司-年度观测样本，我们发现物理气候风险显著降低了投资效率。对文化差异的分析表明，在层级文化中的企业采取更为保守的投资策略，限制了对气候挑战的适应能力，而在风险规避文化中的企业则主动整合气候风险，从而实现更高的投资效率。一项双重差分分析进一步显示，《巴黎协定》在短期内带来了气候相关投资反应的适度改善，但长期挑战依然存在。这些发现强调了将文化背景纳入政策和公司治理策略以增强气候韧性的重要性。为稳健性考虑，我们采用系统GMM估计方法，以帮助应对潜在的内生性和动态企业层面因素。
authors: Adam Arian Ramona Zharfpeykan Richard Busulwa a Peter Faber Business School
Australiab University of Auckland Business School
New Zealandc School of Business Law and Entrepreneurship
title: Physical climate risks and investment behaviour, the role of cultural differences
title_zh: 物理气候风险与投资行为：文化差异的作用

abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of Digital Financial Inclusion (DFI) in alleviating the vulnerability of expected poverty (VEP) among rural households in China by utilizing data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) from 2012 to 2020. The results demonstrate a mechanism that DFI significantly reduces VEP among rural households by stimulating entrepreneurial activities. However, this mechanism exhibits a distinct ‘digital divide’ where households below the poverty line of $1.90 per day fail to utilize DFI to mitigate their VEP status, due to insufficient digital literacy, lower risk tolerance, and higher risk aversion. By analysing the marginal effects of control variables such as the head of household’s occupation, family size, and healthcare, this study provides valuable conclusions and additional empirical evidence to eliminate rural vulnerability. This study carries significant implications for extending the benefits of deepened DFI reforms to greater numbers of impoverished households.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2012年至2020年中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，探讨了数字普惠金融（DFI）在缓解中国农村家庭预期贫困脆弱性（VEP）方面的有效性。研究结果显示，DFI通过激发创业活动显著降低了农村家庭的VEP，但这一机制呈现出明显的“数字鸿沟”现象：日均收入低于1.90美元贫困线的家庭，因数字素养不足、风险承受能力较低及风险规避倾向较高，未能利用DFI来缓解其VEP状况。通过分析户主职业、家庭规模及医疗保障等控制变量的边际效应，本研究为消除农村脆弱性提供了有价值的结论及额外的实证证据。本研究对于将深化DFI改革的红利惠及更多贫困家庭具有重要启示意义。
authors: Wen Yang Rui Yang Chenxiao Zhang Quanliang Chen College of Economics
